escena: SCENE: three colleagues around a standing meeting table in a bright studio, medium shot from the waist up, at the instant Julio (Image 1, left) points at a printed board on the table while Nexa (Image 2, centre) leans in to look at it and Karo (Image 3, right) laughs at something he said; all three look at the board, nobody looks at another person's face up close. Julio wears a dark navy crew-neck sweater, Nexa a dark navy fine-knit top, Karo a royal-blue knit sweater. Each face is lit only by the soft window light of this room, from the left, with gentle fill. A small azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook lies on the table. 50mm lens at f/2.8, camera at about 3 m at chest height.
